## Function Code Acceptance

The acceptance of a code card — a probe tests it, an optional smoke test of its own.

Behaviour: codeAcceptance(ctx, probe, smoke, extra), ctx a Card Context. code = codeTargets of the profile, test = testTarget when smoke is not null, else none. The body, in order: Probe Dir with the probe and ctx.siblings; OWN_GIT_BEFORE when ctx.ownGit; tscStep; eslintStep over ctx.targets; "echo '== guard'; node $P/guard.mjs src <code joined by ','>" + allowArg(ctx.allowed ?? []) + rules' Layers Arg(ctx.allowed ?? [], ctx.layers) (P30) + rules' Rules Arg(ctx.rules) (P31a) plus "; node $P/guard.mjs tests <test> 1 <smoke>" with a test, then "\n"; "echo '== probe'; " + vitestStep with "--config $P/probe.config.mts"; with a test "echo '== own'; " + vitestStep with the test; ESLINT_VERDICT; extra when not null; fullStep(ctx); OWN_GIT_AFTER when ctx.ownGit; frozenStep of ctx.frozen; untrackedStep of ctx.targets. The result is wrapScript(ctx.id, ctx.phase, ctx.targets, body). allowArg(allowed) (exported, P19) = "" when allowed is empty, else " '" + allowed joined by "," + "'" — the guard's third argument, the packages it allows in these code files; ctx.vendor is not read. P37 (#49): RELATED_LINE (exported) = "node_modules/.bin/vitest related --run {test} --reporter=dot"; fullStep(ctx) (exported) = "echo '== full'; " + vitestStep of {...ctx.profile, ownTestLine: RELATED_LINE} with ctx.targets joined by " " + " " + fullArgs(ctx.fullExclude): only the tests that import the targets (cli's Suite Net runs the whole suite once per run).

Steps:
- calls: Wrap Script
- calls: Check Steps
- calls: Tree Steps
- calls: Probe Dir
- reads: Card Context
- uses: rules

## Function Judge Acceptance

The acceptance of a judge card — per test file its bounds, literals and kept names, then the files run together.

Behaviour: judgeAcceptance(ctx, files), files the card's Judge Files in target order. litsJson(lits) = "[" + each literal as JSON.stringify joined by ", " + "]". The body, in order: Probe Dir without a probe; OWN_GIT_BEFORE when ctx.ownGit; tscStep; eslintStep over ctx.targets; for the n-th file (from 0) the heredoc $P/lits<n>.json (MORPH_LITS_EOF) of litsJson and "echo '== guard <file>'; node $P/guard.mjs tests <file> <min> <max> $P/lits<n>.json\n"; namesKept for every file that is not new, with its drop list; "echo '== own'; " + vitestStep with the targets joined by " "; ESLINT_VERDICT; fullStep(ctx), OWN_GIT_AFTER, frozen and untracked as a code card. The result is wrapScript(ctx.id, ctx.phase, ctx.targets, body).

Steps:
- calls: Wrap Script
- calls: Check Steps
- calls: Tree Steps
- calls: Probe Dir
- reads: Judge File

3. given litsJson(["a", "é"]); litsJson([]); when written; then "[\"a\", \"é\"]" (not escaped to \u00e9); "[]"
4. given examples.json["Judge Acceptance 4"].given; when judgeAcceptance; then examples.json["Judge Acceptance 4"].then (ref: tests/fixtures/builder/examples.json, tests/fixtures/builder/judge1.txt)

Data Judge File: One test file a judge writes or patches, with the guard's bounds and literals and the HEAD names it may drop.
Schema:
{ file: string, min: number, max: number, lits: string[], drop: string[], new: boolean }

## Component requirements / guardrails

Requirements:
- Strict TypeScript: tsconfig strict, ESM, no `any`; every module compiles with tsc --noEmit.
- One Document Out: Every command prints exactly one JSON document on stdout and nothing else; the human log goes to stderr.
- Deterministic Core: cards and compiler give byte-identical results for the same inputs: no clock, no randomness, no environment reads. acceptance is bound only in its pure parts (Snapshot Targets, Build Attempt Diff): Run Acceptance spawns a shell and its only timer is the child's timeout; env and the timeout are parameters, never process.env (06.10, P3). processor reads the environment only in Read Registry; Assemble Request, Read Response, Stub Answer, Assemble Batch and Read Batch are pure of clock and network; the transport and its sleep are parameters of Send Generation and Send Batch (P4, P11). git spawns only in Run Git, synchronously, with the child's environment given whole as a parameter; it reads no process.env and no clock of its own (P6). cli touches the process only in its entry src/cli.ts: the environment, the working directory, the clock and the output streams reach main() as parameters, and the environment reaches the processor only through Read Registry (P7). language is pure data and pure functions: no clock, no environment, no file system, no child process; node:path is its only Node module; its shell lines are text (P8). contour reads no file, no clock and no environment: it parses the text it is given; the package yaml is imported in Parse Document alone (P9). planner reads no file, no clock and no environment: the cli reads the record and the map and passes which files exist as a function; node:path is its only Node module (P10a). builder reads no file, no clock and no environment: the caller passes the checks, the cards, the profile and the texts of the guard, the locator and the probes; node:path is its only Node module (P10b). primer reads files and spawns git (git's gitOk, the environment a parameter) only in Primer Command, the clock only there through deps.now; Read Runs, Read Story and Render Primer are pure functions of what they are given, no network anywhere (P12a). scout reads no clock, no environment and no network and spawns nothing: Parse Turn, Spend Budget and Seed From Ownership are pure; Cage Path and Run Tool reach the file system only through the ScoutFs parameter (realpath, readFile); elapsed time is a parameter; node:path is its only Node module (P13a). scout-session reaches the model only through the processor's Send Generation and the clock only through deps.now; Run Scout reads the tree through the ScoutFs parameter; Scout Command and Plan From Scout are the scout layer's two node:fs files (git through gitOk and runGit, node:crypto for the sha256 in Scout Command), the environment a parameter (P13b). reviewer's checks (Find Obligations, Check Envelope, Check Guardrails, Plan Mutants, Render Findings) are pure functions of the record, git's outputs and the texts they are given: no file, no clock, no environment, no child process, no Node module (P14a). review-session spawns only through acceptance's Run Acceptance (the mutant runs, each under its timeout) and git's Run Git; Run Mutants writes only through acceptance's Restore Snapshot; Review Command is the reviewer layer's one node:fs file (the record, the map and scout.json read, the review written), the environment a parameter, no clock and no model call (P14b). debt spawns only through acceptance's Run Acceptance and git's Run Git, reads the deck file, the card's files and the run archive through node:fs, no clock and no model call; the environment is a parameter (P17). scaffold reads the template folders and writes the new project through node:fs (node:url only to find the package root from its own module file), spawns nothing, reads no clock and no environment (P18).
- Node Only: Runtime dependencies: Node 20 built-ins and the package `yaml` (the record reader), nothing else; dev dependencies pinned exactly, no ^ or ~.

Guardrails:
- No Network In Tests: tests/setup.ts makes fetch, XMLHttpRequest, WebSocket and net.connect throw "network blocked in tests"; only the processor's own transport is mocked.
- No Shell Outside Acceptance: child processes are spawned only by Run Acceptance, the git module (in Run Git alone, P6) and the processor's none; everything else is pure.
- Frozen Tree During Run: while a run is in flight no file outside the cards' targets and .morph/ changes; a changed declared input discards the answer unread.
- Pure (definition not found in the record)

TypeScript with `strict` on, ESM with NodeNext resolution: every relative import carries the `.js` extension and types are imported with `import type`. No `any`: use `unknown` and narrow. Write src/cli/suiteNet.ts, a new file. Imports, nothing else: `import fs from "node:fs"`, `import { posix } from "node:path"`, `import { runAcceptance, DEFAULT_TIMEOUT_MS } from "../acceptance/run.js"`, `import { RELATED_LINE } from "../builder/compose.js"`, `import type { Card } from "../cards/types.js"`. Export exactly: `RELATED_MARK` ("echo '== full'; " + RELATED_LINE.slice(0, RELATED_LINE.indexOf("{test}"))), `SUITE_LINE`, `SUITE_SCRIPT`, `interface SuiteResult { command: string; ok: boolean; failing: string[]; cards: string[]; log: string }` and `async function suiteNet(root: string, cards: readonly Card[], env: Record<string, string>, timeoutMs?: number): Promise<SuiteResult | null>`. runAcceptance(command, root, {env, timeoutMs}) resolves {exit: number | null, log: string, timedOut: boolean}; exit 0 is green, anything else (null included) red. A card's acceptance is string | null. A file read: fs.statSync(abs).isFile() in try/catch (absent → not a file), then fs.readFileSync(abs, "utf8"); no process, no env, no clock, no child_process.

## Function Suite Net

The whole suite once per run, after the last generation, when the deck's acceptances ran only the related tests (P37,

Behaviour: suiteNet(root, cards, env, timeoutMs?) → Promise<Suite Result | null>, src/cli/suiteNet.ts. RELATED_MARK = "echo '== full'; " + builder's RELATED_LINE up to "{test}" (= "echo '== full'; node_modules/.bin/vitest related --run "). No card's acceptance (a string) holds RELATED_MARK → null, nothing run. Else SUITE_LINE = "node_modules/.bin/vitest run --reporter=dot" (the typescript profile's fullRunLine) runs once: r = acceptance's Run Acceptance(SUITE_SCRIPT, root, {env, timeoutMs}), SUITE_SCRIPT = "L=$(mktemp); " + SUITE_LINE + " > $L 2>&1; rc=$?; [ $rc = 0 ] || grep -E '^ FAIL ' $L || tail -20 $L; rm -f $L; exit $rc". r.exit 0 → {command: SUITE_LINE, ok: true, failing: [], cards: [], log: r.log}. Else ok false; failing = every line of r.log that starts " FAIL  ", the rest after those 7 characters, each once, first seen first; the failing files = the first space-separated word of each; cards = the customIds, deck order, of the cards with a target that is a failing file or a file one of them imports, directly or through other files: per file read (UTF-8, at root, each once) every specifier of `from "<s>"`, `import "<s>"` and `import("<s>")` (either quote) that starts "./" or "../", joined to the file's directory (posix, normalised), a ".js" ending made ".ts"; a path that is not a regular file at root is dropped. log = r.log.

Steps:
- uses: acceptance
- uses: builder
- reads: Card
- produces: Suite Result

Examples (the tests must prove each one):
1. given examples.json["Suite Net 1"].given; when suiteNet; then examples.json["Suite Net 1"].then (ref: tests/fixtures/cli/suiteNet.json)
2. given examples.json["Suite Net 2"].given; when suiteNet; then examples.json["Suite Net 2"].then (ref: tests/fixtures/cli/suiteNet.json)
3. given examples.json["Suite Net 3"].given; when suiteNet; then examples.json["Suite Net 3"].then (ref: tests/fixtures/cli/suiteNet.json)
4. given examples.json["Suite Net 4"].given; when suiteNet; then examples.json["Suite Net 4"].then (ref: tests/fixtures/cli/suiteNet.json)

Data Card: One unit of work for an executor; what morph run compiles into a request.
Schema:
{
  "customId": "string, ^[A-Za-z0-9._-]+$",
  "intent": "'generate' | 'patch'",
  "targets": "string[] non-empty, repo-relative, distinct after normalisation",
  "contextSlice": "string[] default []",
  "instruction": "string non-empty",
  "acceptance": "string | null — a shell command run from the repo root",
  "model": "string | null",
  "maxTokens": "number | null",
  "reasoning": "{ maxTokens: number } | { effort: 'low'|'medium'|'high' } | null",
  "variants": "number >= 1, default 1",
  "dependsOn": "string[] default []"
}

Data Suite Result: What the run's whole-suite net found (P37).
Schema:
{ command: string, ok: boolean, failing: string[], cards: string[], log: string }

## Component requirements / guardrails

Requirements:
- Strict TypeScript: tsconfig strict, ESM, no `any`; every module compiles with tsc --noEmit.
- One Document Out: Every command prints exactly one JSON document on stdout and nothing else; the human log goes to stderr.
- Deterministic Core: cards and compiler give byte-identical results for the same inputs: no clock, no randomness, no environment reads. acceptance is bound only in its pure parts (Snapshot Targets, Build Attempt Diff): Run Acceptance spawns a shell and its only timer is the child's timeout; env and the timeout are parameters, never process.env (06.10, P3). processor reads the environment only in Read Registry; Assemble Request, Read Response, Stub Answer, Assemble Batch and Read Batch are pure of clock and network; the transport and its sleep are parameters of Send Generation and Send Batch (P4, P11). git spawns only in Run Git, synchronously, with the child's environment given whole as a parameter; it reads no process.env and no clock of its own (P6). cli touches the process only in its entry src/cli.ts: the environment, the working directory, the clock and the output streams reach main() as parameters, and the environment reaches the processor only through Read Registry (P7). language is pure data and pure functions: no clock, no environment, no file system, no child process; node:path is its only Node module; its shell lines are text (P8). contour reads no file, no clock and no environment: it parses the text it is given; the package yaml is imported in Parse Document alone (P9). planner reads no file, no clock and no environment: the cli reads the record and the map and passes which files exist as a function; node:path is its only Node module (P10a). builder reads no file, no clock and no environment: the caller passes the checks, the cards, the profile and the texts of the guard, the locator and the probes; node:path is its only Node module (P10b). primer reads files and spawns git (git's gitOk, the environment a parameter) only in Primer Command, the clock only there through deps.now; Read Runs, Read Story and Render Primer are pure functions of what they are given, no network anywhere (P12a). scout reads no clock, no environment and no network and spawns nothing: Parse Turn, Spend Budget and Seed From Ownership are pure; Cage Path and Run Tool reach the file system only through the ScoutFs parameter (realpath, readFile); elapsed time is a parameter; node:path is its only Node module (P13a). scout-session reaches the model only through the processor's Send Generation and the clock only through deps.now; Run Scout reads the tree through the ScoutFs parameter; Scout Command and Plan From Scout are the scout layer's two node:fs files (git through gitOk and runGit, node:crypto for the sha256 in Scout Command), the environment a parameter (P13b). reviewer's checks (Find Obligations, Check Envelope, Check Guardrails, Plan Mutants, Render Findings) are pure functions of the record, git's outputs and the texts they are given: no file, no clock, no environment, no child process, no Node module (P14a). review-session spawns only through acceptance's Run Acceptance (the mutant runs, each under its timeout) and git's Run Git; Run Mutants writes only through acceptance's Restore Snapshot; Review Command is the reviewer layer's one node:fs file (the record, the map and scout.json read, the review written), the environment a parameter, no clock and no model call (P14b). debt spawns only through acceptance's Run Acceptance and git's Run Git, reads the deck file, the card's files and the run archive through node:fs, no clock and no model call; the environment is a parameter (P17). scaffold reads the template folders and writes the new project through node:fs (node:url only to find the package root from its own module file), spawns nothing, reads no clock and no environment (P18).
- Node Only: Runtime dependencies: Node 20 built-ins and the package `yaml` (the record reader), nothing else; dev dependencies pinned exactly, no ^ or ~.

Guardrails:
- No Network In Tests: tests/setup.ts makes fetch, XMLHttpRequest, WebSocket and net.connect throw "network blocked in tests"; only the processor's own transport is mocked.
- No Shell Outside Acceptance: child processes are spawned only by Run Acceptance, the git module (in Run Git alone, P6) and the processor's none; everything else is pure.
- Frozen Tree During Run: while a run is in flight no file outside the cards' targets and .morph/ changes; a changed declared input discards the answer unread.
- No Shell (definition not found in the record)
- No Network (definition not found in the record)
- No Env (definition not found in the record)
- No Process (definition not found in the record)

Data Run Document: stdout of run.
Schema:
{ runId: string, branch: string, base: string, report: RunReport, archive: ArchiveResult, suite?: Suite Result }

Callee Read Deck File: The deck file a command names, read by Load Deck.
Behaviour: readDeckFile(root, deckPath): abs = path.resolve(root, deckPath). Not a regular file → {ok: false, result: {code 4, document errorDocument(4, "UsageError", "deck file not found: <deckPath as given>")}}. Else Load Deck on its UTF-8 text; faults → {ok: false, result: {code 2, document errorDocument(2, "DeckError", "invalid deck: " + each "<key>: <message>", "; "-joined)}}. Else {ok: true, deck}.

Callee Suite Net: The whole suite once per run, after the last generation, when the deck's acceptances ran only the related tests (P37,
Behaviour: suiteNet(root, cards, env, timeoutMs?) → Promise<Suite Result | null>, src/cli/suiteNet.ts. RELATED_MARK = "echo '== full'; " + builder's RELATED_LINE up to "{test}" (= "echo '== full'; node_modules/.bin/vitest related --run "). No card's acceptance (a string) holds RELATED_MARK → null, nothing run. Else SUITE_LINE = "node_modules/.bin/vitest run --reporter=dot" (the typescript profile's fullRunLine) runs once: r = acceptance's Run Acceptance(SUITE_SCRIPT, root, {env, timeoutMs}), SUITE_SCRIPT = "L=$(mktemp); " + SUITE_LINE + " > $L 2>&1; rc=$?; [ $rc = 0 ] || grep -E '^ FAIL ' $L || tail -20 $L; rm -f $L; exit $rc". r.exit 0 → {command: SUITE_LINE, ok: true, failing: [], cards: [], log: r.log}. Else ok false; failing = every line of r.log that starts " FAIL  ", the rest after those 7 characters, each once, first seen first; the failing files = the first space-separated word of each; cards = the customIds, deck order, of the cards with a target that is a failing file or a file one of them imports, directly or through other files: per file read (UTF-8, at root, each once) every specifier of `from "<s>"`, `import "<s>"` and `import("<s>")` (either quote) that starts "./" or "../", joined to the file's directory (posix, normalised), a ".js" ending made ".ts"; a path that is not a regular file at root is dropped. log = r.log.
